the Income Tax Department has detected

of providing educational loans by all banks
including private banks?

emphasized the need to spruce up the city

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

(c) whether all formalities relating to
land acquisition have been sorted out and
the Central Government's clearance has
been obtained; and
(d) the total period of the project and
the approximate amount to be incurred on
this project?
Revamping of DGCA
713. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:

civil aviation sector, there has been no
commensurate efforts to strengthen the
DGCA set-up;

instituted in 2005 had called for
strengthening the manpower base of DGCA
in every department;

creation of an Airport Economic Regulatory
Authority is expected to lessen the burden

the working models of airport regulators in
the US and the European Union for
possible revamping of DGCA?
Female pilots
714. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of female pilots are increasing day by day
in the aviation sector in India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the future programmes of
Government for further increase in the
number of female pilots?

Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased

spurt and phenomenal increase in the

all major airports to be crowded and
congested and worse than bus-stands;

installation?

domestic and international flights operated

workers are easy targets of unruly

taken by Government to avoid such
incidents?
Recruitment grade in I.A.

abnormal delays in Delhi due to inadequate
number of ATCs;

Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
